objective: Speak with Carendin Halgar in the Undercity.

description: Ah, <name>! I just received word from Carendin Halgar that he would like to see you for further training.
You should be proud of yourself, <name>. It's not every day that Master Halgar personally sees fit to instruct a young warlock.
You'll be able to find him in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, near the Temple of the Damned.
completion: Good, I see Ageron managed to find you, <name>. Let us waste little time with small talk and pleasantries and focus on your training. There is still much you have to learn.
